name: Griesner Alm
beschreibung: The Griesner Alm is an inn in Kirchdorf in Tirol. It is located in the Gries district at an altitude of around 1,000 meters. The terrace offers a view of the Kaisergebirge. The inn serves traditional Tiroler dishes. Guests can stay overnight in the rooms. In summer, the Alm serves as a starting point for hikes. In winter, a cross-country ski trail runs directly past the house.
